coverage_gaps.sentence: Glassware must, of course, be clean, and CGMP regulations consider laboratory equipment to be included within the scope of 21 CFR 211.67.
Residues must not exceed their established acceptance limits and must not adversely alter drug product safety, efficacy, quality, or stability (see references below).
